data.name: Oswald
data.gender_notes: Oswald is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English elements ōs 'god' and weald 'power'. The name Oswald means 'wealthy ruler' in Old English. This name was popular among the Anglo-Saxons and was borne by several early Christian kings. The name Oswald carries the meaning “Wealthy ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Oswald usually hope their child will grow to embody wealthy ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Oswald belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wealthy ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Oswald total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: אוסוולד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אוסוולד הוא שם שמקורו בשפה הגרמנית ומשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא השולט בעולם'. השם מורכב משני חלקים: 'אוס' שפירושו אלוהים ו'וולד' שפירושו שלטון או עולם. השם אוסוולד היה נפוץ בקרב הנוצרים בימי הביניים וקושר לאישיותו של הקדוש אוסוולד, מלך נורתומבריה.

in_greek.name: Όσβαλδος
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι ο κυβερνήτης του κόσμου
in_greek.long_meaning: Όσβαλδος είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από τη γερμανική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι ο κυβερνήτης του κόσμου'. Το όνομα αποτελείται από δύο μέρη: 'Όσ' που σημαίνει Θεός και 'βαλδός' που σημαίνει κυβερνήτης ή κόσμος. Το όνομα Όσβαλδος ήταν κοινό μεταξύ των Χριστιανών κατά τον Μεσαίωνα και συνδέθηκε με την προσωπικότητα του Αγίου Όσβαλδου, βασιλιά της Νορθουμβρίας.

in_latin.name: Oswald
in_latin.long_meaning: Oswaldus est nomen quod oritur ex lingua germanica et significat 'Deus est dominus mundi'. Nomen constat ex duabus partibus: 'Os' quod significat Deum et 'wald' quod significat dominationem seu mundum. Nomen Oswaldus fuit commune inter Christianos in medio aevo et coniunctum est cum persona Sancti Oswaldi, regis Northumbriae.

in_english.name: Oswald
in_english.meaning: God is ruler of the world
in_english.long_meaning: Oswald is a Christian name derived from Germanic roots, meaning 'God is ruler of the world'. It is composed of two elements: 'Os', meaning God, and 'wald', meaning rule or world. The name Oswald was popular among Christians during the Middle Ages and is associated with Saint Oswald, King of Northumbria, who played a significant role in the spread of Christianity in England.

data.cultural_impact: Oswald is associated with several significant historical figures in Christian history. King Oswald of Northumberland (604-642 AD) was an early Christian king of Northumbria who is credited with the conversion of his people to Christianity. He is often depicted in art and literature as a brave and just ruler, inspiring a sense of admiration for his abilities as a leader and his commitment to his faith.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Oswald has a deep spiritual significance for Christians, reminding us of the power and wealth that comes from God. It is a reminder that true prosperity and abundance come not from material possessions, but from the divine power and guidance of God. The name Oswald is also a testament to the enduring power of faith and the transformative effect it can have on individuals and communities. Regardless of the specific activities or endeavors associated with someone named Oswald, the name itself carries a rich spiritual meaning that resonates with the values and aspirations of the Christian faith.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Oswald: God's strength in God. The name Oswald is derived from the Old English elements os, meaning God, and weald, meaning power or rule. This name symbolizes the belief that true strength comes from God.

name_in_real_life.story: David Oswald, a minister in London, United Kingdom, shares that their name Oswald meaning "Wealthy ruler" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
